<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='IHC.ITF.Request.traumaConsolidationRequest' sourceDocType='DemogrInitiate:Demogr_Generic' create='new' language='objectscript' > <assign value='context.msprId' property='target.traumaConsolidation.userMspr' action='set' /> <trace value='"#### TransTime(Before conversion): "_source.{MSH:DateTimeOfMessage.timeofanevent}' /> <assign value='source.{MSH:DateTimeOfMessage.timeofanevent}' property='msgDateTime' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(msgDateTime) > 13' > <true> <assign value='$E(msgDateTime,1,8)_" "_$E(msgDateTime,9,10)_":"_$E(msgDateTime,11,12)_":"_$E(msgDateTime,13,14)' property='transTime' action='set' /> <trace value='"#### TransTime: "_transTime' /> <assign value='$ZDTH(transTime,8,1)' property='zdthTransTime' action='set' /> <trace value='"#### ZDTH TransTime: "_zdthTransTime' /> <trace value='"#### $ZDATETIME TransTime: "_$ZDATETIME(zdthTransTime,3,5)' /> <assign value='$ZDATETIME(zdthTransTime,3,5)' property='target.traumaConsolidation.transactionTime' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{ZZZ:OriginalSendingApplication}' property='target.traumaConsolidation.application' action='set' /> <assign value='context.empiNum' property='target.traumaConsolidation.keepEmpi' action='set' /> <assign value='context.userName' property='target.traumaConsolidation.userName' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MRG:PriorPatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' property='target.traumaConsolidation.deleteEmpi' action='set' />
</transform>
